description: This line plot illustrates the Bit-per-Character (BPC) on a validation dataset across training steps for the SMoE Routing Policy. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps" with a multiplier of "(x10³)", featuring a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 50 with tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "BPC" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 1.2 to 2.2, with tick marks spaced every 0.2. The plot contains two lines. The line representing "SMoE Validating" is a solid teal line with small cross markers; it begins at a peak value near 2.2 at 0 training steps, experiences a sharp decline to approximately 1.4 by 10 training steps, and then follows a steady, gradual decline to end at approximately 1.2 at 50 training steps. The line representing "SimSMoE Validating" is a solid magenta line with small cross markers; it also starts at a peak value near 2.2 at 0 training steps, sharply declines to roughly 1.4 by 10 training steps, and continues with a gradual decline to finish at approximately 1.2 at 50 training steps.
